# started at time

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:startedAtTime`](gmeow-startedAtTime.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/startedAtTime>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The instant at which a time interval begins.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) -> [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:startedAtTime`](gmeow-startedAtTime.md) from [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) to [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to stamp the start of a [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) as a single crisp dateTime when no separate [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md) object is needed — the lightweight inline bound.

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the start needs its own frame, granularity, or EDTF value (promote to [`gmeow:hasStartInstant`](gmeow-hasStartInstant.md) on a [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md)) and avoid an [xsd:date](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#date) literal — base-triple time is [xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) (P3).

### How to use

- Write a full [xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) including the offset interpreted by the interval's [`gmeow:hasTemporalFrame`](gmeow-hasTemporalFrame.md); pair with [`gmeow:endedAtTime`](gmeow-endedAtTime.md), or omit the end to leave the interval open.

### Examples

- ex:tenureInterval [`gmeow:startedAtTime`](gmeow-startedAtTime.md) "2019-03-01T00:00:00Z"^^[xsd:dateTime.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime.)
